cohort: The study included 43 neonates with sepsis and suspected meningitis, categorized into meningitis (n=22) and non-meningitis (n=21) groups.
finding: A CSF Procalcitonin cut-off value of 0.13 ng/ml showed a sensitivity of 86.36% and specificity of 23.81% in diagnosing neonatal meningitis, indicating it can serve as a reliable additional diagnostic biomarker.
